eventLocation: Mullu kuttai Kulam(Thirumukudal panchayat, kanchipuram Dist.)
eventDescription:
With the financial support of PUTHIYA THALAIMURAI TV, VIDHAIGAL has started the restoration of water bodies for the first time.

The restoration of the MULLU  KUTTAI POND in THIRUMUKUDAL Panchayat of SALAVAKKAM Union, KANCHIPURAM District was flagged off by UTHIRAMERUR MLA K . SUNDAR .The work was also flagged off by the  Puthiya Thalaimurai Trust Managers, Panchayat President and the local public.
